name: Mieux Food Taxonomy
scope: Food and beverages sold in French supermarkets
classification_policy: Assign one primary product_type to each product; use attributes for brand, flavour, recipe, size, packaging, organic status, dietary claims and nutrition claims.
Do not infer a product type from brand alone.
If evidence is insufficient, use an unclassified/needs_review workflow rather than forcing a match.
A shared substitution_group is a candidate retrieval hint, not proof that two products are interchangeable.
Apply exact compatibility checks for intended use, form, preparation, ingredients and dietary constraints before recommending alternatives.
Use the comparison_unit as a default only; normalize actual prices to €/kg or €/L when package quantity and drained weight are known.
French supermarket availability is a separate evidence field and must not be inferred from taxonomy membership.
